auth.usernameRule: 1–32 characters: letters, digits, - and _. Starting with a letter or a digit, and not only digits
auth.passwordChooseHint: Choose a password, {{min}} characters or more.
auth.createConfirm: Nobody is using “{{name}}” yet. Create an account with it?
auth.forgotBody: rab cannot send a new one out. Write to the administrator at {{email}}, say which account is yours, and they will set one.
auth.forgotNoAdmin: No administrator address is set. Add VITE_ADMIN_EMAIL to .env.
auth.forgotMail: My rab account is {{name}}. I have forgotten my password — please set a new one for me.
auth.emailHint: An email address, to send a verification code to.
auth.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
auth.emailTaken: That email address already has an account.
auth.mailFailed: The email could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
auth.codeExpired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.codeTooSoon: A code was just sent. Wait a minute before asking again.

account.title: User
account.locationsHint: Places you keep to put your items at. Changing one here does not move items already placed there.
account.contactsHint: How you are reached, in order: a primary contact, a secondary one and so on. Your primary contact is a message here on rab until you put another first. An item that follows your contact settings shows these.
account.emailHint: The address of the account itself. It is separate from the contact details below and is not shown to anyone.
account.birthdateInvalid: Enter a real date of birth

event.gone: an item that has been removed

map.title: Map
map.noToken: The map needs a Mapbox token: set VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN in .env.
map.areaEmpty: Nothing is listed in this area yet.
map.areaEmptyAsk: Be the first to publish something.
map.requestsEmpty: Nobody is asking for anything in this area yet.

item.minDurationHint: The shortest one booking can be: a whole number of steps.
item.regionPlaceholder: Search for a city, region or postcode
item.regionRequired: Pick the area it is offered in
item.regionHint: Required. Filled in with the city you are in. Anyone looking at this area on the map sees it in the list, even without a location.
item.title: Name
item.whatHint: A few words for what this is, such as “Film camera” or “Hair salon”.
item.descriptionPlaceholder: What it is, what's included, anything people should know
item.locationHint: Drag the pin, or press the map, to where the item is picked up. The pin is public — a nearby landmark is fine.
item.missing: This item does not exist or has been removed.
item.ageRequired: This item is in the Adult category. Set your date of birth on your account to see it.
item.categorySpotHint: The spot's main category. When it holds items of several categories, you can choose "No category".
item.photosHint: Up to 100 photos, compressed before upload. The first is the main photo and is shown on the map — press a photo to make it the main one.
item.generateHint: Fills in the category, name and description from the main photo and the two after it — three at most.
item.classifyFailed: The category could not be chosen. Pick it yourself.
item.generateUnavailable: This server is not set up to fill this in from the photo.
item.generateBusy: Too many photos at once. Try again in a moment.
item.generateFailed: This could not be filled in from the photo. Fill it in yourself.
item.locationName: A name for it — Home, the studio
item.locationOptional: Optional. Without one the item is not on the map, and is found by search and by its link.
item.availabilityHint: The days it can be had are the ones the usual hours tick. On the calendar, press a date to close it, or to open one the usual hours leave out. Press the pencil beside a date's price to give it a default price of its own.
item.availabilityHintTime: Tick the days of the week it can be had. Press the pencil beside a date's price to give it a default price of its own.
item.previewNote: This is the booking page people will see. It is a preview: pressing Add does not publish it either — press Publish on its page when it is ready.
item.previewEmpty: There is nothing to preview. Open the item form and press Preview.
item.previewBlocked: The browser blocked the preview tab. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
item.ruleTimesWrong: A price rule's hours need a start before their end
item.dayRulesHint: The usual hours: the days they are for, and when it can be picked up and returned — add as many as you need. Start and end times of a booking are chosen within these hours; leave the times empty for the whole day. Days no rule ticks cannot be booked.
item.dayHoursWrong: Set both ends of each usual hours rule, the start before the end
item.hourRulesHint: The usual hours: the days they are for, and from when to when. Without any, only what is painted below can be booked.
item.hoursRequired: Say which hours it can be booked
item.hoursHint: What the hours above come to in the week shown; the arrows turn to another week. Drag to paint hours for one date only; drag from a painted spot to erase. Scroll with the column of times on the left.
item.unitHint: The step a booking grows by. The hours below are set in this step too.

modeHint.time: Available for a day and a stretch of hours.
modeHint.inquiry: Nothing is booked here: people contact you directly and you arrange it together.

item.offerRequired: Offer it for sale, for free, for use, or more than one.

pricingHint.day: What an ordinary day costs. To price one date differently, press the pencil beside it on the calendar below.
pricingHint.time: The price of one step of the available time: with a 15-minute step, this is what 15 minutes cost. To price one date differently, press the pencil beside it on the calendar below.
pricingHint.inquiry: The usual price, for the stretch of time picked under “Price per”, shown as a guide. The final price is agreed when you are contacted.

item.datePriceHint: Left empty, this date costs the overall default price.
item.extraRates_one: {{count}} earlier price rule is still in force.
item.extraRates_other: {{count}} earlier price rules are still in force.
item.slotPriceHint: Left empty, this time costs what the date does.
item.contactMessageNote: By a message here on rab
item.contactHint: Shown on the item page to anyone who opens it. The primary contact is required; add more with +.
item.contactFollowHint: Shown on the item page as they are in your account. Change them in your account settings; untick to write contacts for this item only.
item.sharedNote: Listed on someone else’s behalf. Anyone signed in can edit it.
item.inquiryExplainShared: Use the contact details above to arrange it.
item.modeHintShared: Someone else’s can only be booked by inquiry: people contact them directly with the details below.

calendar.title: Availability
calendar.pick: Pick the first and the last day.
calendar.dayBooked: {{date}} is already booked. Cancel that booking first.
calendar.pickDay: Pick a day to see its timetable.
calendar.pickSlots: pick a start and an end time
calendar.noHours: No bookable hours on this day.

booking.timeOrder: The end time must be after the start time.
booking.explain: Nothing is charged here. The owner confirms or declines, and you arrange payment and the details by message.
booking.unavailable: Some of those days are no longer available.
booking.already: You have already asked for those days.
booking.requestsEmpty: Nobody has asked for this yet.
booking.yoursEmpty: You have not asked for this item.
booking.signedOut: to see the status of your bookings.

mine.title: Mine
mine.wantedEmpty: You are not looking for anything yet. Write what you need in the bar at the top.
mine.itemsEmpty: You have nothing listed. Press + to publish something.

user.missing: There is nobody by that name.

travel.title: Go to
travel.failed: Could not look that up just now

gate.body: rab shows what is listed around you. Allow location so the map can open where you are.
gate.deniedHint: Allow this site to use your location, then try again. On iPhone: turn on Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services and set “Safari Websites” to “While Using the App”, or tap the aA button in the address bar > Website Settings > Location > Allow. Until then the map stays on your country’s capital.
gate.failedHint: The device gave no position. Check that Location Services are on and you have signal, then try again.
gate.insecure: This page cannot get your location
gate.insecureHint: Browsers only give a position to pages on https or localhost. Open rab at an https address.

ask.failed: The AI could not answer just now. You can still search for it.
ask.busy: Too many questions at once. Try again in a moment, or search for it.

share.title: Share
share.lead: Send the link, or put the QR code on a flyer or a screen. Anyone can open the page and ask to book.

cancel.any: A confirmed booking can be cancelled at any time.
cancel.none: A confirmed booking cannot be cancelled.
cancel.days_one: A confirmed booking can be cancelled up to {{count}} day before it starts.
cancel.days_other: A confirmed booking can be cancelled up to {{count}} days before it starts.
cancel.late: It is too late to cancel this booking.
cancel.askExplain: You can ask {{name}} to cancel it for you. They will see your request in their messages and can agree or refuse.
cancel.hours_one: A confirmed booking can be cancelled up to {{count}} hour before it starts.
cancel.hours_other: A confirmed booking can be cancelled up to {{count}} hours before it starts.

review.title: Rate {{name}}
review.explain: This booking is complete. How was it with {{name}}? Your rating and comment are shown on their profile.
review.explainRental: This booking is complete. How was it with {{name}}, and how was the item? Your ratings and comment are shown on their profile and on the item's page.

others.empty: You have not booked anything yet.

report.title: Report
report.lead: What is wrong with “{{item}}”? Your report is sent to the administrator as a message.

reasons.unavailable: No longer available (ask the administrator to delete it)
reasons.infringement: Infringes my rights (ask the administrator to delete it)

spot.title: Spots
spot.empty: No spots yet. Make one with Publish (+), choosing Spot.

publish.itemHint: One thing, space or service to provide, with its own photos, price and calendar.
publish.pageHint: A spot is a collection of several items, and need not be a real place. Use it as the home of a shop, a venue or a service.
publish.spotHint: Tick one or more of your spots. Your default spot, named after you, is ticked to start with, and at least one stays ticked.

request.missing: This request could not be found.
request.title: I need
request.whatPlaceholder: e.g. A stroller, or help moving house
request.whenHint: Leave empty if any time works.
request.fillInUnavailable: This server is not set up to fill this in.
request.fillInFailed: This could not be filled in. Fill it in yourself.
request.contactHint: Shown on the request, so anyone who can help can reach you.
request.titleRequired: Say what you are looking for.
request.placeRequired: Choose a request area, or add a location.
request.anonymousHint: Your username is not shown — not on the request, and not in the messages people send you about it on rab.
request.photosHint: Optional. A photo of the kind of thing you are looking for.
request.regionHint: Filled in with the city the map is on. Anyone looking at this area sees the request in the list, even without a location.
